subject: CS480
filterSummary: Successfully selected 10 videos (5 English, 5 Arabic) covering all specified topics. Selections were made based on strict relevance, quality, and hard gates for duration and viewership. For several Arabic topics, the number of eligible candidates was low, primarily due to low view counts, but suitable videos were found for all required slots.

coverage.note: Only one candidate passed the view count and duration gates.
